component.name: Folio
component.summary: Offline vector handwriting and notes for Linux

description.p: Write pressure-sensitive notes with a stylus, organize notebooks, annotate PDFs and search titles, tags and typed text. Your original ink stays editable and private.
No account or cloud service is required.

Reduce whole-page work during edits and drawing, cache paper geometry, prepare images off the UI thread and bound background results. Fix stale previews, duplicate document loads and repeated failed shape fitting.

Polish the native interface with finite panel transitions, animated switches and reduced motion. Improve keyboard and dialog safety, preserve selections when closing menus and protect pen input during tab loading.
Remove handwriting OCR, text detection and math recognition, including model workers and packaging. Preserve vector ink, typed text, shape gestures and existing documents.
Independent Home PDF imports, correct PDF page geometry, document management menus, draggable tabs and improved local handwriting recognition with equation review.
Minimal neutral light and dark themes, customizable appearance and optional themed paper with readable ink.
Reliable held-pen shape snapping with endpoint tremor tolerance, rough shape fitting, open arcs and two-stroke arrows.
Solid overlapping ink, broader scribble erasing and temporary circle selection that returns to the pen.
More reliable scribble erase and encircle selection with precise ink targeting.
New notebook library, document tabs, writing toolbar and page thumbnails.
